mods.name: Bulk Cities
mods.author: Age of Clicks Mod API
mods.description: Found many cities quickly: found-city mode stays on and every city is named for you, with the real town at that spot or a name in the region's style. Can also fill your land with its real towns.

mods.name: AI Diplomacy
mods.description: Talk to any country's leader in your own words. An AI plays the leader from live game data and can agree to anything in the mod API's action catalog; deals happen when you accept them.

mods.name: Replays
mods.author: Age of Clicks Mod API
mods.description: Films your single-player games with the game's own graphics from a cinematic camera that follows your country and its wars. Needs ffmpeg.
